heading: Magdalen Rozsa
subtitle: Sydney-based Artist
aboutText:
Magdalen Rozsa is a practising Sydney-based artist who has worked across several media including mosaic, watercolour, oil, acrylic, and print-making.

She finds inspiration from many sources with overarching themes of nature and the world around her.
aboutCta: For enquiries about commissions or available works, please get in touch via email.
